name: College of Spirits

source.note: Entered from the 2025 Unearthed Arcana (Horror Subclasses) and published reviews of Ravenloft: The Horrors Within; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Bards who call the spirits of the dead through cards and candles, for help that is powerful but never quite under control.

feature.name: Channeler
feature.summary: Guidance (60-foot range); proficiency with playing cards, which (like a crystal, orb, candle or ink pen) serve as your Bard focus.
feature.text: Guiding Whispers: you know the Guidance cantrip, and its range is 60 feet when you cast it. Spiritual Focus: you gain a set of playing cards and proficiency with them, and you can use them, a crystal or orb, a candle or an ink pen as a Spellcasting Focus for your Bard spells.

feature.name: Spirits from Beyond
feature.summary: Bonus Action, a Bardic Inspiration use: roll the die and a spirit acts on a creature you see within 30 feet (heal, blast, teleport, frighten and more).
feature.text: While holding a Spellcasting Focus, you can take a Bonus Action and expend a use of Bardic Inspiration to channel a spirit. Roll your Bardic Inspiration die, read the result on the Spirits from Beyond table, and choose one creature you can see within 30 feet as the spirit's target; it takes effect at once, and any save uses your Bard spell save DC. 1 Beloved: the target regains Hit Points equal to one roll of your Bardic Inspiration die plus your Charisma modifier. 2 Sharpshooter: the target takes Force damage equal to one roll of the die plus your Charisma modifier. 3 Avenger: until the end of your next turn, any creature that hits the target with a melee attack takes Force damage equal to a roll of the die. 4 Renegade: the target can use its Reaction at once to teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. 5 Fortune Teller: the target has Advantage on D20 Tests until the start of your next turn. 6 Wayfarer: the target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to a roll of the die plus your Bard level, and its Speed is 10 feet higher while it has them. 7 Trickster: Wisdom save; on a failure two rolls of the die in Psychic damage and Charmed until the start of your next turn, on a success half the damage only. 8 Shade: the target is Invisible until the end of its next turn or until it attacks, deals damage or casts a spell; when that ends, each creature within 5 feet of it makes a Constitution save or takes two rolls of the die in Necrotic damage. 9 Arsonist: Dexterity save, four rolls of the die in Fire damage, half on a success. 10 Coward: the target and each creature of your choice within 30 feet of it make a Wisdom save or are Frightened until the start of your next turn; while Frightened this way a creature's Speed is halved and it takes an action or a Bonus Action, not both. 11 Brute: each creature of your choice within 30 feet of the target makes a Strength save; on a failure three rolls of the die in Thunder damage and Prone, on a success half the damage only. 12 Controlled Channeling: you pick any other row.

feature.name: Empowered Channeling
feature.summary: Once per turn +1d6 to a Bard spell's damage or healing; Spirit Guardians always prepared, free once per Long Rest, and once per Short Rest it can also give Half Cover.
feature.text: Power from Beyond: once per turn, when you cast a Bard spell that deals damage or restores Hit Points, roll a d6 and add it to one damage roll or to the Hit Points restored. Spiritual Manifestation: you always have Spirit Guardians prepared and can cast it once without a slot, regaining that on a Long Rest. When you start casting it you can have the spirits also shield the living: you and your allies within its Emanation have Half Cover. Once you do that, you can't again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

feature.name: Mystical Connection
feature.summary: Roll twice on the Spirits from Beyond table and pick either effect.
feature.text: Whenever you roll on the Spirits from Beyond table, you can roll the die twice and choose which of the two effects happens.
